title: Wall Shooting Form Check
description: Players shoot a soft one-handed form shot against a wall from close range, isolating a clean release with no rim to distract from the mechanics.

content.objective: Build a clean one-handed release and follow-through without worrying about making a shot.
content.setup: Players stand about two metres from a wall, ball in the shooting hand with the guide hand lightly on the side.
instructions: Shoot the ball softly at a spot on the wall using one hand only.
Snap the wrist on release and hold the follow-through until the ball returns.
Catch the rebound and repeat for ten reps, then switch to two-handed set-up with a one-handed finish.
Finish with ten reps focusing only on a high, relaxed elbow.
coachingPoints: Hold the follow-through — don't drop the arm early.
Keep the guide hand off the ball at release.
Aim for a consistent release point every time.
commonMistakes: Pushing the ball with the guide hand at release.
Dropping the elbow out to the side instead of keeping it under the ball.
Letting the elbow drift out to the side instead of staying under the ball.
content.safety: Make sure the space near the wall is clear of other players' rebounds.
